name: mcp-servers
description: Runs Model Context Protocol servers (Git, and CodeRAG semantic search where supported) inside VS Code, bound to loopback and protected by a bearer token.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The servers read and run what a workspace contains (git repositories, their configuration and settings, files to index), so they only run in a workspace you trust.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The servers need real folders on a local or remote file system (git and the CodeRAG index cannot work on a virtual file system).

mcpServers.git.autoStart.description: Start the Git MCP server automatically when VS Code opens with a workspace folder, and when a folder is opened later.

mcpServers.git.port.description: Port of the Git MCP server on 127.0.0.1. Changing it restarts a running server. 0 picks a free port (the URL then changes on every start).

mcpServers.coderag.autoStart.description: Start the CodeRAG MCP server automatically when VS Code opens with a workspace folder. Off by default: starting it indexes the workspace, which costs CPU, disk space and embedding requests (the first start of a large repository takes a while).

mcpServers.coderag.port.description: Port of the CodeRAG MCP server on 127.0.0.1. Changing it restarts a running server. 0 picks a free port (the URL then changes on every start). Workspace settings may override it; a taken port only makes the server fail to start.

mcpServers.coderag.watch.description: Watch the workspace folders and re-index files as they change. Turn it off if watching a very large folder strains the system (OS file watcher limits); the index is still updated when CodeRAG starts, after a search that meets changed files and by the sync_documents tool. Changing it restarts a running server.

enumDescriptions: Every tool: also indexing, deleting, frontmatter, listing and relation tools. Their definitions add about 1.3k tokens to every session.
mcpServers.coderag.toolset.description: Which CodeRAG tools MCP clients see. Tool definitions are sent to the model in every session, so the default offers only search, get_index_status and sync_documents. Changing it restarts a running server.

mcpServers.coderag.embeddingUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint, for example http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama. Required to start CodeRAG. Machine scoped: a repository's .vscode/settings.json cannot redirect your code to another endpoint. The API key is not a setting; use the command "MCP Servers: Set CodeRAG API Key".

mcpServers.coderag.embeddingModel.description: Name of the embedding model, for example nomic-embed-text. Required to start CodeRAG.

mcpServers.coderag.embeddingDim.description: Number of dimensions of the embedding vectors; must match the model. It applies when a new index is created. An existing index keeps the dimension it was created with: a different value here is ignored and a warning is written to the MCP Servers output. To change the dimension, delete coderag.db in the workspace storage so the index is created again.

mcpServers.coderag.chunkSize.description: Target size of a text chunk, in characters, when indexing documents.

mcpServers.coderag.topK.description: Number of results a search returns by default.

mcpServers.coderag.docsInclude.description: Glob patterns of the documents to index. Empty means all Markdown and MDX files (*.md, *.mdx) in the workspace folders. Machine scoped because the patterns decide which files are read and sent to the embeddings endpoint.

mcpServers.coderag.docsExclude.description: Glob patterns of documents to leave out of the index.

mcpServers.coderag.codeInclude.description: Glob patterns of the source files to index. Empty means the supported languages in the workspace folders. Machine scoped because the patterns decide which files are read and sent to the embeddings endpoint.

mcpServers.coderag.codeExclude.description: Glob patterns of source files to leave out of the index.

mcpServers.coderag.useGitignore.description: Skip files ignored by .gitignore when indexing.

mcpServers.coderag.allowedRoots.description: Absolute directories outside the workspace folders that CodeRAG tools may read and write. Empty means only the workspace folders and the base directories of the include patterns. Machine scoped: a repository's .vscode/settings.json cannot widen file access.
